top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Develop and implement policies and procedures for flu and pneumonia vaccinations.
Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Educate residents and staff on COVID-19 vaccination, offer the COVID-19 vaccine to eligible residents and staff after education, and properly document each resident and staff member's vaccination status.
Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
